We have,

$y = {x}^{2} + x + 10$

$⇒ {x}^{2} + x + \dfrac{1}{4} = y - 10 + \dfrac{1}{4}$

$⇒ {\left(x + \dfrac{1}{2}\right)}^{2} = \left(y - \dfrac{39}{4}\right)$

Latusrectum of parabola is $1 .$

$∴$ Length of chord is also $1 .$

Area is maximum when chord is latusrectum.
Area of shaded region$=$Area of rectangle $OABC - 2{∫}_{- 1 / 2}^{0}$parabola

Let ${A}_{1}, {A}_{2}$ and ${A}_{3}$ be the regions on $R^{2}$ defined by

${A}_{1} = \left\{\left(x, y\right): x \ge 0, y \ge 0, 2x + 2y - x^{2} - y^{2} > 1 > x + y\right\}$

${A}_{2} = \left\{\left(x, y\right): x \ge 0, y \ge 0, x + y > 1 > x^{2} + y^{2}\right\}$

${A}_{3} = \left\{\left(x, y\right): x \ge 0, y \ge 0, x + y > 1 > x^{3} + y^{3}\right\}$

Denote by $\left|{A}_{1}\right|, \left|{A}_{2}\right|$ and $\left|{A}_{3}\right|$ the areas of the regions ${A}_{1}, {A}_{2}$ and ${A}_{3}$ respectively. Then
questions.solution:
Area of region defined by 

${A}_{1} = \left\{\begin{array}{ll}( x, y ) : x \ge 0, y \ge 0, 2x + 2y - x^{2} \\ - y^{2} > 1 > x + y\end{array}\right\}$ is $\left|{A}_{1}\right|$.

Similarly, $\left|{A}_{2}\right|$ is the area of region defined by 

${A}_{2} = \left\{\left(x, y\right): x \ge 0, y \ge 0, x + y > 1 > x^{2} + y^{2}\right\}$

Here, $\left|{A}_{1}\right| = \left|{A}_{2}\right|$

and area $\left|{A}_{3}\right|$ is the area of region defined by ${A}_{3} = \left\{\left(x, y\right): x \ge 0, y \ge 0, x + y > 1 > x^{3} + y^{3}\right\}$
then $\left|{A}_{3}\right| > \left|{A}_{2}\right| = \left|{A}_{1}\right|$
